text: The product itself is good. It’s a lightweight serum that quickly absorbs into the skin. It left my undereyes feeling hydrated which in turn does reduce the appearance of the fine lines that I have under there. It is lightly scented, but nothing that is too overpowering or irritating to the senses. The packaging could use some work.  I feel like I have to use quite a bit of pressure to get some product out.  And the applicator tip seemed too big and wasn’t comfortable to use under my eye.  I opted to squeeze some product on my ring finger and applied it that way. Overall it’s a good product but at the price point it is,  I would choose a different, more Affordable product that has the same results
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

text: Meh, pretty average. The formulation itself is great. It is scented however it was not too strong and it didn’t irritate my eyes. The eye cream is light and goes on smooth. My under eyes feel nice and hydrated after each use. I did not notice much improvement with puffiness but the hydration did make my fine lines appear more diminished. I used this every night for about a month. The applicator requires too much pressure to get product out. Though I love the concept, I prefer to have a simple tube to squirt product out as needed on my fingers. I honestly don’t plan on purchasing this. There are plenty of other eye creams that will achieve the same effect for less
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

text: Like But Don’t Love. I received this product to try out in a voxbox. The main thing I really like about this product is the applicator. It’s elongated oval shape really lets you get in there and the grooves help to make sure you’re evenly distributing the product. The applicator is made of metal which gives a cool massaging feel when applying serum.The serum itself has a good consistency. It’s not runny but it’s not thick either. The fragrance is very light and not overpowering.While using this product, I did notice some slight smoothing of the skin in terms of fine lines with n my under-eye area but not to the degree that the packaging makes it seem like you will experience. My eyes never appeared larger and my bags did not appear lifted as the product claims. I definitely would not spent the $80 this product retails for based on my results. It definitely feels like they’re charging more for the name than actual performance/serum results. I like this product but I don’t love it
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

text: Worth it?. I received this item complimentary from Influenster & Dior in exchange for my honest review. I was super excited to try this product out. I really like the packaging and the application process. The serum aborns very easily and feels good on the skin. I have been using every night for about three weeks now and haven’t seen any improvements though. So I was shocked when I saw this was recommended by 90% of reviewers. Is it a nice eye serum? Yes, but if it’s not actually doing anything than I can’t see myself purchasing this in the future. I would have expected some results by now. I’m going to continue using it and hope for the best. To each is own, try at your own risk
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

text: Not for me. I was fortunate enough to be chosen to sample this eye serum for my honest opinion on it. I absolutely loved the tip on it. The metal felt good spreading the serum under my eyes. I felt that it definitely helped with the puffiness and bags under my eyes that I tend to suffer with daily (no matter hope much sleep I get or water I drink) but I felt it didn’t help at all with the fine lines and wrinkles I have around my eyes. I also wasn’t thrilled about how strong it is scented. It actually made my eyes water when I applied it because the smell was so strong. I’m glad I was given the opportunity to try this but I think I’ll stick with the eye serum I’ve been using that costs only a fraction of the price of this Dior serum
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

text: Worth it, if you have the budget for it.. The product is overall, easy to apply and rather convenient given its design. The applicator is pretty neat but short lived, considering it’s supposed to feel nice and cool since it’s metal but it quickly warms up after finishing one eye. Prior to using this specific product, my eyes were in decent condition as I already had a product I was using prior to receiving this. Not puffy or dark, but just some little lines here and there. I stopped using my daily eye creams and just used the Dior product once in the AM and once in the PM so I can get a true review of the effects. The results were very slight for me personally- again, I don’t have a lot of wrinkles or eye issues, just some light wrinkles. I began seeing results after 2 consecutive weeks of use, the lines became more faint than they were when I first started using this product. By week 3 and 4, there was minimal change and I was okay with that. For $80, it’s a steep price - I saw similar results for a product that runs $54. The trick to these eye creams is that when you do stop using it, the lines return so it’s not a permanent solution and I saw this when I forgot to pack this during vacation to Aruba for a week. When I returned the same results came back. Overall, I would recommend if you want something luxurious. It does what it says, but only as long as you continue to use the product. Maybe I need to finish the entire bottle before permanent results, however I haven’t gotten to that point yet
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

text: Meh. The applicator is so nice it felt cooling and it glides so smooth no tugging on that delicate skin, unfortunately the serum is kinda scented and it made my eyes water and sting a little instantly, I gave it to my mom and she loves it, I haven’t seen much change in her burly isn’t only been a week or so. I got it from influenster
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

text: Okay but nothing special. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review from Influenster. The eye serum is a medium weight thickness that isn’t runny or too creamy and applies with a smooth oval metal applicator. The applicator feels nice on the skin but is a bit awkward to fit in the tear duct/inner corner area. The serum feels nice and hydrating but pretty sticky if you apply to the eye lids.  I feel like my under eyes look a bit plumper and brighter but nothing dramatically improved and the affects seem pretty temporary. I don’t notice my fine lines being diminished after use or over time and I’ve tested this product nightly for about a month. Maybe it would be more noticeable if I had more defined wrinkles but for the price, there’s better more affordable options out there
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

text: I was super excited to try this product as I usually love all things Dior. This serum is silky smooth and I love the applicator on the product but I’ll admit that I haven’t seen any noticeable difference. I feel like these products usually take some time to see any improvement or changes and thus far, not much. But a good eye serum is important so I’ll keep using and see what happens!
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

text: Nice product, terrible packaging. The packaging is the biggest flaw. It’s a hard plastic you have to try to squeeze to get the product out. If you squeeze too hard, too much comes out. The metal tip is nice and cooling, but will drag if you don’t have enough product on it. The serum itself was nice. I found it hydrated my under eyes, but didn’t notice any reduction of wrinkles. It didn’t irritate my eyes and played nice with my skin
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

text: This cream is okay, but I’m not a fan of the very strong, heavy scent
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

text: Dior cream. Whe I received the product I was having a hard time opening and closing lid. Not sure if the alignment was off or it was me. The cream was very rich and creamy so it moisturized well. I did think the smell was a little strong for a facial cream but did smell nice. I did receive this cream as complimentary and I am not sure I would pay that much for this cream in the future
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

text: Heavily scented. I received this for free from Influenster to review. Like most Dior products, it is heavily scented. The first day I applied it, I found it to be a nice product. It went on smoothly for as thick as it was. I did not experience burning on the dry patches on my face. It did not leave my skin feeling greasy. However, the next time I applied it, the smell was too strong for me that day and I ended up with a migraine. I’ve been afraid to use it since then
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

text: First of all, I received this product for free to review and test from Influenster. I have used this for almost a month now, twice a day. Once in the morning and once before bed. I have combination skin and to me it is a heavy moisturizer but soaks in very quick and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy. It did make my face feel very hydrated, but at the end of this month I really haven’t seen much of a difference in my skin!! It comes with a cute little spoon to apply the creme which I loved. I wasn’t a fan of the lid on the jar. It was a little aggravating to open and close. The smell is nice and light. It isn’t a bad product, but to me the price is too high for not much improvement in my skin
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

text: Incredibly Rich. This cream is wonderful it just wasn’t for me. My skin is dry in the winter and needs something with more moisture punch but this was too balmy for my skin and didn’t absorb nicely. This cream has a lingering beautiful floral scent so it may not be for you based on that alone. If you have intensely dry skin this is definitely something to grab
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

text: This Dior cream is very potent and rich as the name claims. It is thick, but feels light on the skin. It should be a win with how well it moisturizes, however, the scent is so strong that it is completely overwhelming. I wouldn’t consider myself sensitive to fragrances and it made me gag. I can’t say if it reduces fine lines and wrinkles, because I couldn’t continue using it with the heavy smell. I wish they made an unscented version as I really love the cream itself!
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

text: A little Oily feel. I received this product for free to try from Influenster for a complimentary review. I can’t say that I am impressed with this product. I do like the look of the packaging and the cream itself, and I really appreciate that it has a little spoon to avoid contamination of the product. I also like that a little goes a long way, so you don’t have to use that many product. I don’t like that the scent is too strong (it has a perfume scent) and I feel it’s a little on the oily side. For dry skin this may work great, but for normal or combination skin, I would not recommend it as a daytime cream. It may work as a nighttime cream. I think it is on the expensive side, so I wouldn’t recommend for someone with normal or combination skin since it is too heavy and will likely only use it for nighttime, it is more worth the money for someone with dry skin since a little goes a long way and that type of skin will really take benefit off of it
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

text: I really wanted to like this but unfortunately my skin did not like it. And it is very scented, it’s not a bad scent but it is very strong and lasts a long time.It is very a good moisturizer and it sinks in very nice and doesn’t leave a greasy feeling at all. Unfortunately my skin reacted badly to it from the fragrance. If you don’t have sensitive skin I would recommend it.I received this product free for testing purposes
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

text: Dior. This product was ok. Not a fan of the sensation it gave me on my face. But I like it helped with fine lines. Tip: keep away from your lip line it gave me a undesirable feeling
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

text: Rich and creamy. I received this product free from Influenster. I am combo mostly oily skin type so I don’t use this product often. I can’t speak to its anti aging benefits because I am in my 20s but it is thick, creamy and rich. I like to layer hydrating serums and mists on my skin before sealing them in with this product at night. Beware if you are sensitive to fragrances. It’s not an in pleasant clean floral smell but if you don’t like scented skincare stay away
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

text: An investment which may or may not be worth it. I got a sample of this and a sample of the NuFace creams. They are quite different from each other, so not exactly comparing apples to apples. The Dior cream was much more intense. I felt sharp tingling to light burning sensations for a few minutes - but I will say the blemishes cleared up overnight with this product! A sample was not enough to confirm the firming/anti-aging claims. With the overnight results on blemishes, I was impressed. I ended up buying the full size NuFace instead for these reasons: much lower price mark (obviously) and far more gentle on the skin (no burning) with same blemish-clearing results. I’d like to try a couple full size bottles of the Dior since I’m really looking for firming (something NuFace didn’t live up to) but I don’t think the price mark is worth the disappointment expressed by others
product_name: Capture Totale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Cream

text: Main impression, it’s very fragrant. I could still smell it after an hour from application. The texture feels thin but as applied to the skin, it will feel a bit thick and sticky for five minutes until it gets absorbed. Observed nothing for a change but this is just my initial thought as I’ve only used it a few times from a sample
product_name: Capture Totale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Cream

text: I love Dior and their products have been awesome for me in the past, but they keep changing the lineup so right when I get a routine figured out they discontinue what I’m using.  I bought this cream because my skin is always too dry over the winter.  This is definitely a very deeply moisturizing night cream type of product.  I feel like it moisturized my skin well but I also saw an increase in breakouts.  I bought it twice because it seemed to get used up fast, there isn’t a ton of product especially for the price
product_name: Capture Totale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Cream

text: Not A Good Choice.. Did not like…it pilled and was too thin of a consistency. I forgot to keep my receipt and original box the covered the container. Now I cannot return it. So sorry I tried this.  I am 62 years old
product_name: Capture Totale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Cream

text: 3.5/4 stars out of 5 for this firming and wrinkle correcting cream. Pros: really lovely, thick cream that does feel luxurious. For full background, my face routine has typically been Drunk Elephant & Tatcha. My usual suspects are DE Lala retro, retinol, protini polypeptide cream, and the Tatcha cleansing oil and violet C serum. I added this Dior to the mix in place of lala and protini for a couple of weeks. At first, my face reacted with a little breakout, but after a few days, it settled back down. I did feel like my skin looked and felt more moisturized and glowy. The packaging is also beautiful- definitely well-made. The jar is a heavy glass and it comes with an applicator as well so you can keep it uncontaminated. Things I personally didn’t love: it’s quite strongly-scented, and the scent is lovely, but it doesn’t smell totally natural - a bit more concentrated than that. The smell does dissipate pretty quickly, but I’m a bit sensitive to smells (can sometimes trigger headaches) so I noticed I’d automatically avoid this if my head was feeling prone to a headache that night. A little heavy: I put this on one morning and let it sink in before going out and still saw that my face was really shiny all day. I only put it on at night after that. If you do it at night and shower in the morning, it’s not really a problem. I don’t know that I would buy it again because I’m sensitive to this smell, and I like my products to feel more natural, but if they got a fragrance free version, I would definitely give it another shot!
product_name: Capture Totale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Cream

text: Nice Texture, Strong Scent. The Dior Super Potent Rich Creme is aptly named for it’s rich and thick texture. It is still able to blend into the skin well and doesn’t sit on the surface like a film how some thick moisturizers do. It does have a strong scent of baby powder which I don’t love but it is tolerable. I would prefer less scent or a better scent. It does leave my combination skin moisturized without feeling too oily. I will use this up but I don’t think I would repurchase as I have other moisturizers that I would prefer over this one
product_name: Capture Totale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Cream

text: Worth a try. More like 3.75 stars if I could really pick. The cream is very luxurious for sure. It might feel a little thick but it goes on like silk and dries beautifully (very fast compared to others I’ve tried). My skin felt nourished but not greasy at all, supple and I’m more on the oily side. The scent is very light, like a watered down citrus and cucumber scent, not offensive at all and disappears pretty fast. I have trouble with hormonal acne and on top of that, now “mask-ne” issues from wearing masks 12 + hrs. It didn’t do very much for my acne/problem areas and I wasn’t expecting it to. But the other half of my face did appear more radiant and healthy. I did see some slight slight improvement with some of my under eye wrinkles but mostly my under eyes appeared less crepey when wearing makeup so I was pleased with that at least. I didn’t use the product sparingly and I’ve been using for a little more than a month now and I still have about 1/4 left. So I think price wise it’s reasonable if used in moderation. I wish I could’ve tried this when I was having a better skin month to really see its full potential. Since I received this as a free sample from Influenster in exchange for my review I had to start using it soon after I got it. Perhaps I will give it another try in the near future and get a better feel for it. Definitely worth a re-try
product_name: Capture Totale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Cream

text: Disappointed. I received this from Influenster to give my honest review. The jar is glass, heavy weighted, looks and feels luxurious. It came with a plastic spatula which was a nice touch but nowhere to store it. I would have liked to have seen a place to store it in the cap. I feel there was definitely a missed opportunity there. If you are going to go through the trouble of providing a spatula please provide a place in the cap to store it for easy access to it as well as to keep it sanitary. I ended up not using the spatula at all due to having to store it somewhere else that I would have to locate it first in order to utilize this feature. The jar itself was extremely hard to open for the first time. It would not open for me at all. I tried for hours to get the jar open only to finally give up on it for the night. The next morning I was finally able to get the jar opened and I was excited to start using the product. Upon opening the jar and removing the plastic protector I was immediately put off by the extreme scent of roses. I am not opposed to fragrance in skincare at all and I actually enjoy the scent of roses but the scent is overwhelming in my opinion. I suffer from migraines and over the top fragrance can trigger reactionary migraines for me. I am happy to report that even though it is extremely fragranced this product did not cause any reactionary migraines. The cream is thick,  luxurious and absorbed into the skin well. Even though the cream is thicker in consistency you do not need much of the product to cover your face, neck and décolletage. I did experience some pilling when combined with my other serums with this product so I stopped using it at night and used only in the morning without using my essence, serums or oils. I did not notice any significant reduction in wrinkles or firmness or the skin. I did notice a boost in radiance of my skin but honestly this is not enough to repurchase sadly
product_name: Capture Totale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Cream

text: I expected more. I am sad to say, this is pretty much your standard moisturizer. I have other Door skin products I love but unfortunately this didn’t do what it claimed. I used it religiously and my skin was hydrated but it didn’t do much in the way of radiance, help with fine lines etc
product_name: Capture Totale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Cream

text: The fragrance was a bit strong , the cream is very light weight though. I have only been using it at night , but my skin does feel softer , not sure I notice less fine lines or not though. A little goes a long way so it will last a while
product_name: Capture Totale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Cream

text: At first I wasn’t a fan of it because it smelled like paint or glue to me but after rubbing it on my skin I could smell the chamomile. This balm is however moisturizing without feeling too thick, after application my skin feels smooth without feeling like I put on thick lotion. I do find that it’s a bit too pricey to use all over my body so I would just limit it to my face and hands. Overall I find it okay, I like that it’s formulated without synthetic fragrances but just not worth the price
product_name: Cica Recover & Repair Multi-Use Balm

text: I like this cica multi-use balm but I don’t love it. It does the job well of calming and hydrating the skin, however, I don’t think it’s worth the price tag. I think I would reach for other high end skincare products first. It does hydrate and soothe the skin nicely, and I enjoy using it as the last step in my nighttime skincare routine. I apply a dime sized amount to my face and neck to lock in moisture. It worked well in calming my skin after have sensitivity due to retinol. I don’t apply too much because the balm texture can become sticky if too much product is applied. I also like using it as a mask, applying a thick layer for 10 mins then wiping away the excess. Since it is Dior skincare, I wish there was a nice scent to the product for more of a luxurious experience
product_name: Cica Recover & Repair Multi-Use Balm

text: Worth a look for sensitive skin. I sampled this moisturizer for free through Influenster. I used it exclusively over a scar on my back from a recent mole removal. I guess for the price of this product I was expecting more of a miracle in the reduction of redness at my scar, so I was a bit disappointed. I will say, if you’re in the market for cream that’s non-greasy and suitable for sensitive skin, this is the one. I just couldn’t personally justify the price to buy for myself
product_name: Cica Recover & Repair Multi-Use Balm

text: Nice product. It is a little too heavy for my face but I love it on my neck ,chest and hands!
product_name: Cica Recover & Repair Multi-Use Balm

text: Good Multi-Use Cream. The Dior Cica Recover & Repair Multi-use Balm is a good cream for face and body. I received a tube to try from Influenster. I used the cream on my dry arms and as a night cream before going to bed. It hydrated my face and arms and did not leave a greasy residue. The cream has no detectable scent. For the price, I feel this cream is too expensive to use on the body. There are so many other body creams and lotions that can moisturize for less money. That is why I gave it three stars. I will probably use this as my next night cream. Otherwise it is a nice cream
product_name: Cica Recover & Repair Multi-Use Balm

text: I use this throughout the day on my hands, and I think it does a good job moisturizing in the short term, but I don’t think it helps with lasting moisture. Would recommend for a less dry area of the body that doesn’t need as intense moisturizing
product_name: Cica Recover & Repair Multi-Use Balm

text: I have normal skin with very occasional slight dryness so was interested in trying this product. Overall, I liked it. It did provide  moisturization but for me it was a bit too much. It felt like a very thick cream. I did not notice a scent to it but that is fine. I would recommend this product for someone with much drier skin than mine
product_name: Cica Recover & Repair Multi-Use Balm

text: Decent moisturizer. I used Dior’s Cica Recover and Repair Multiuse Balm for 2 weeks while stopping all other skincare to fairly assess its strengths. My first impression of the minimalist packaging and tube was that it might be a no nonsense, highly effective product. It has a very mild gentle fragrance which may come specifically from its ingredients and not added perfumes and dyes. I have some sensitivity and hyperpigmentation issues from reactions occasionally, so this was much appreciated. The cream itself is balmy in texture, but spreads easily and doesn’t leave a greasy feel behind. A little doesn’t go a long way, and I needed about 2 large pea size dollops to cover my whole face and neck. It spread easily and sank in without leaving a greasy film, but I didn’t feel that it moisturized extraordinarily well. It was good nevertheless, and my skin felt adequately soft while I wore it. It also seemed to calm some rashes and irritation i developed from a new cleanser last week. With the Dior name, the minimalist packaging and quality ingredients I expected this cream to blow me out of the water. Perhaps my expectations were a little high. With those managed, I would say this is a good if not great moisturizer
product_name: Cica Recover & Repair Multi-Use Balm

text: TO PREVENT DRYNESS on top of your routine.. I received this product from Influenster in exchange for my honest review and let me tell you, if I had paid $60 for this cream I would’ve been returning. I love the minimalistic bottle design, good size, fits in all of my purses. It does have like a really clean scent that you can bearly notice and I like that. BUT I just feel that it doesn’t work for dryness. I have really dry hands and when I put it in I do feel my skin soft but it’s like a glove sensation because if I move my hand I still can feel the dryness underneath. WEIRD. This is perfect just for the daily use like any other cream but fancier and maybe TO PREVENT dryness. You can use it on top of you moisturizer
product_name: Cica Recover & Repair Multi-Use Balm

text: Don’t love it. I received this product from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This was up against another long-standing moisture surge cream that I have been using and ultimately, the original one just won out. After using this Dior balm for a few days I woke up with a dry, flaky red patch on my cheek which was something I was able to avoid all winter prior to switching from my old product to this new one. This may have been a coincidence, hence the 3 stars, but ultimately I would not buy this product again as I have another one that is just more effective
product_name: Cica Recover & Repair Multi-Use Balm
